title: Be accredited to arrange out-of-home care
what: Place children in, or arrange, statutory or supported out-of-home care (foster care) only as a designated agency accredited by the Children's Guardian.

laws.title: Children and Young Persons (Care and Protection) Act 1998 (NSW)

sources.quote: Arrangements for the provision of statutory or supported out-of-home care may be made only by— (a) a designated agency, or (b) the Children's Guardian.
